policies.name: PII Redaction
policies.description: Redacts detected PII from agent inputs and outputs before persistence.

policies.description: Blocks agent outputs that appear to contain secrets/keys/tokens.

policies.name: Human Approval Required
policies.description: Blocks stage promotion when a required approval gate is missing.
